newsitem.title: UK: UK's Northern Rock members say yes for bank status.
newsitem.headline: UK's Northern Rock members say yes for bank status.

text.p: Members of Britain's Northern Rock Building Society approved on Tuesday its plans to convert itself into a bank, domestic news agency The Press Association said on Tuesday.
Each of its 900,000 members are expected to receive 500 free shares when the society floats on the stock exchange later this year.
A Northern Rock spokesman confirmed the vote and told Reuters that 97 percent of both borrowers and investors who voted were in favour of the conversion.
The value of the shares will be between 1,300 and 1,475 stg based on a valuation by the society's advisers J.P. Morgan.
The flotation is day is expected to be October 1.
Northern Rock, with an existence dating back to the 1850s, has assets of 13.7 billion stg.

"We are extrmely pleased that so many of our investing and borrowing members took part in the voting process and that the board's conversion proposals received such an overwhelming endorsement," its chairman Robert Dickenson said.
